method_name: Bayesian Virtual Epileptic Patient (BVEP): probabilistic inversion of the network Epileptor model

primary_source.authors: Hashemi M, Vattikonda AN, Sip V, Guye M, Bartolomei F, Woodman MM, Jirsa VK
primary_source.title: The Bayesian Virtual Epileptic Patient: A probabilistic framework designed to infer the spatial map of epileptogenicity in a personalized large-scale brain model of epilepsy spread
primary_source.article_license: cc by-nc-nd (per Europe PMC); not flagged open access in Europe PMC
primary_source.verified_via: Crossref + Europe PMC abstract; full text not read
related: Hashemi et al. 2021 PLoS Comput Biol 17:e1009129 (priors)
Jha et al. 2022 Mach Learn Sci Technol 3:035016
Hashemi et al. 2023 Neural Networks 163:178-94 (amortised SBI)
primary_source.related_note: related citations as listed in the BVEP README; not individually verified

method_summary: Bayesian inversion of a 2D Epileptor network (source- or SEEG-level) to infer the spatial map of epileptogenicity x0. Implementations in Stan (NUTS, ADVI, MAP), PyMC3, simulation-based inference (sbi: MAF/MDN/NSF) and global optimisation. The VBT_INS_Stimulation Stan inference (vep_mcmc.stan) follows the same design.
required_inputs: SEEG gain matrix (contact positions from CT/MRI)
SEEG seizure recording -> log-power envelope features with onset annotation
priors on x0 (optionally informed by clinical hypothesis)

implementation_versions.contents: Stan/ (BVEP1-3 .stan models + patient1 NUTS/MAP notebooks, Epileptor2D_Hypos.stan, shell runners), SBI/ (sbi notebooks, BVEP_Simulator.py), PyMC3/, Optimization/, TVB/, SEEG/, Prior/; no requirements file or package metadata at top level

supported_outputs: posterior over regional x0 (epileptogenicity map), global coupling K, noise/scale parameters
validation_setting: Technical note. The abstract reports that NUTS and ADVI accurately estimate the degree of epileptogenicity of brain regions, with convergence diagnostics and posterior behaviour analysis supporting reliability. Details of synthetic vs patient data not extracted (full text not read).
limitations: Notebook-style research code, not a package; versions unpinned (PyMC3 deprecated)
Performance depends on parameterisation (abstract: non-centred parameterisation more efficient)
Posterior on x0 is a fitted estimate, not a calibrated probability of seizure freedom

local_run_requirements.python: 3.10/3.11 with cmdstanpy + CmdStan and a C++ toolchain (Windows: cmdstanpy-installed RTools/MinGW toolchain, or WSL2)
local_run_requirements.optional: torch + sbi for amortised SBI; PyMC3 path not recommended

study_family_id: VEP-INS-Marseille-LaTimone (Jirsa/Bartolomei group; patient overlap across VEP papers not reported - to_verify)
